_about: Canonical get-found checklist. state.py builds the project ledger from this. cadence_days = how often the item is re-verified even if nothing changed; triggers = events that make it due immediately. Override per project in .get-found/checklist.override.json.

items.title: Google Search Console connected
items.done_when: Domain property verified (DNS TXT) or URL-prefix property verified; sitemap submitted with status Success; no unresolved critical issues in Pages/Indexing report.

items.title: Bing Webmaster Tools connected
items.done_when: Site verified (import from Google Search Console is fastest), sitemap submitted and processed, API key stored as env var if automation is wanted.

items.title: IndexNow pings on change
items.done_when: Key file hosted at site root and matches config; every new/changed/deleted URL submitted after deploy.

items.title: XML sitemap accurate
items.done_when: Sitemap generated by the framework (not hand-maintained), lists every canonical indexable URL and nothing else, accurate <lastmod>, referenced from robots.txt, submitted to Google and Bing.

items.title: Crawlable & indexable
items.done_when: robots.txt valid and not blocking important paths; https + single host; self-canonicals; no accidental noindex; real 404s; mobile viewport.

items.title: A real title (+ description, favicon)
items.done_when: Every indexable page has a unique, descriptive <title> that leads with what the page is (primary keyword) and ends with the brand; unique meta description; favicon.

items.title: Preview image on every page
items.done_when: Every page has og:title/og:description/og:image (absolute, ~1200x630, light file) and twitter:card=summary_large_image; platform caches refreshed after changes.

items.title: Structured data (schema.org)
items.done_when: Organization (or LocalBusiness/Person) + WebSite on the homepage with logo and sameAs; Article/BlogPosting with dates and author on posts; type-specific markup (Product, SoftwareApplication, etc.) where eligible; validates in Rich Results Test.

items.title: Pages AI can read
items.done_when: Main content is in the server-delivered HTML (SSR/SSG/prerender), one clear h1, answer-first sections, no nosnippet on pages meant to be cited; optional llms.txt kept current.

items.title: AI bots allowed
items.done_when: robots.txt allows every AI search and user-triggered fetcher (training bots per owner's choice); CDN/WAF bot settings don't silently block them; bot list re-synced with vendor docs.

items.title: Listed in the right directories
items.done_when: At least 10 relevant, legitimate listings live (by site type) with consistent name/URL/description, tracked in .get-found/listings.json.

items.title: Social profiles linked both ways
items.done_when: Official profiles exist with the same name/logo/URL, site links to them, homepage JSON-LD sameAs lists them, link previews validated on each platform.

items.title: One real keyword per page
items.done_when: Every indexable page has one primary keyword (real search demand, matching intent) recorded in keywords.json, used in title/h1/intro, no two pages targeting the same keyword.

items.title: 1 blog post / week
items.done_when: A useful post targeting a backlog keyword published within the cadence, with author, dates, OG image, internal links, and submitted via sync.

items.title: Measure & report
items.done_when: Monthly report saved: Search Console + Bing clicks/impressions/top queries, AI referral traffic, keyword movement, next month's actions.

items.title: Rules synced with live docs
items.done_when: rules.py refresh ran within the cadence; every changed source reviewed and any rule change recorded in .get-found/rules-notes.md and override files.
